name: Murabaha Business Finance
features: Sharia-compliant: the bank's profit is agreed upfront and no interest is charged
The bank buys equipment or fit-out and sells it to the business at an agreed profit
Total cost is fixed and known from day one
Terms from 1 to 5 years
Instalments can be set lower during a known slow season
limitations: Finances specific assets only, not general cash
Business must have been trading for at least 2 years
Existing finance commitments reduce the maximum amount

name: Business Overdraft
features: Draw cash any time up to an agreed limit
Pay only for the amount used
Useful for short-term cash gaps
limitations: Interest of 9% a year on the amount used
Limit is reviewed every 12 months and can be withdrawn

name: Islamic Savings Account (Mudaraba)
features: Sharia-compliant: profit share paid monthly instead of interest
Withdraw any time
No minimum balance
limitations: Profit rate is expected, not guaranteed
Lower expected return than fixed-term products

name: Education Savings Plan
features: Fixed monthly deposit from QAR 500
Guaranteed return of 3.5% a year
Capital protected
Matures on a chosen date to pay school or university fees
limitations: Early withdrawal loses the guaranteed return
Monthly deposit is fixed for the whole term

name: Equity Growth Fund
features: Invests in global company shares
Higher potential long-term return
Minimum investment QAR 5,000
limitations: Value can fall; capital is at risk
Recommended only for 7 years or more

name: Global Transfer Account
features: Sharia-compliant: no interest is charged or paid
First 2 international transfers each month are free
Fixed fee of QAR 10 per transfer after that
Same-day transfers to the Philippines, India, Egypt and Pakistan
limitations: No interest or profit paid on the balance
